          IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF

          COMPANY FOR AN ORDER OF THE
          COMMISSION APPROVING ITS NEW                                PUD 2026-000046
          EXTRA LARGE LOAD TARIFF AND TERMS
          AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE FOR
          EXTRA LARGE LOAD CUSTOMERS AND A
          REGULATORY ASSET TO RECOVER
          COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PORTFOLIO
          OPTIMIZATION SOFTWARE


                           ATTORNEY GENERAL’S ENTRY OF APPEARANCE

                The undersigned counsel appears on behalf of Gentner F. Drummond, Attorney General of

         Oklahoma, to protect the interests of utility customers in the above-referenced proceeding pursuant

         to 74 O.S. § 18b(A)(21) and OAC 165:5-9-4(d).

                Please provide service of any filings, discovery requests, or discovery responses

         electronically to utility.regulation@oag.ok.gov. For all other communications regarding this

         matter, please contact the undersigned counsel.
